canonical.title: Walking-distance lodging at or near Le Coquillage

parent.title: A weekend at Le Coquillage: where to sleep, what to do, what's bookable

siblings.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of Le Coquillage
siblings.summary: Eleven hotels and chambres d'hôtes between on-site at Château Richeux and a 30-minute taxi ride away — sorted by what kind of weekend you're actually planning.

siblings.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of Le Coquillage
siblings.summary: What to do in the 30-km circle around the Roellinger family's three-star Le Coquillage — Saint-Malo's ramparts, Cancale's oyster market, Dinard's Belle Époque, Mont-Saint-Michel and the inland heritage triangle.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of Le Coquillage
siblings.summary: Saint-Malo (9 km from Le Coquillage) is the only nearby IT-conference hub. 2026 calendar is bunched April–May — CPS-IoT Week, PQCrypto, Trois Océans. Next upcoming: Digital Benchmark in September.

sources.title: Le Coquillage — Maisons de Bricourt
sources.claim: Le Coquillage restaurant address and core booking info — at Château Richeux, Le Buot, 35350 Saint-Méloir-des-Ondes; phone +33 2 99 89 64 76.

sources.title: La Ferme du Vent — Cancale Tourisme
sources.claim: Ferme du Vent is 400–500 m on foot from Château Richeux and shares the same gardens.

sources.title: Haras des Nielles — chambres-hotes.org
sources.claim: Haras des Nielles in Les Nielles, 35350 Saint-Méloir-des-Ondes; from €50/night, 5 rooms plus cottage, breakfast included.

sources.title: La Petite Bergère — official site
sources.claim: La Petite Bergère chambre d'hôtes at Les Nielles, Saint-Méloir-des-Ondes — rooms from €85, check-in 17h–19h.

sources.title: Château Richeux — Maisons de Bricourt
sources.claim: Château Richeux is 5 km from Cancale on the D155 toward Mont-Saint-Michel; 12-room Relais & Châteaux with on-site Le Coquillage.

sources.title: Le Coquillage — Relais & Châteaux
sources.claim: Le Coquillage is the in-house fine-dining restaurant of the Château Richeux property within the Relais & Châteaux network.

sources.title: Saint-Méloir / Château Richeux trail viewer
sources.claim: Les Nielles is approximately 1 km from the Le Buot/Château Richeux lodging cluster on the same D155 corridor.

sources.title: Le Coquillage — Ille-et-Vilaine Tourisme
sources.claim: Le Coquillage opening hours — Tuesday through Saturday, 12h–14h and 19h–23h30, closed Sunday and Monday.

sources.title: Château Richeux — Michelin Guide hotels
sources.claim: Château Richeux 2026 availability windows — closed late January–early March and after 23 December; otherwise open year-round.

sources.title: Château Richeux review — Fodor's
sources.claim: Château Richeux rooms are spice-named, run roughly $197–$348 standard (~€180–€320), suites from $369; sea-view supplement €80–100; breakfast not included.

sources.title: La Ferme du Vent — Le Fooding
sources.claim: Ferme du Vent rates — €275 first night then €200 subsequent; package incl. 2 meals/2 breakfasts at €590; 5 'kled' gîtes.

sources.title: La Petite Bergère — Booking.com
sources.claim: La Petite Bergère is highly rated on Booking — 9.1 for couple stays, located near Cancale (5 min) and Saint-Malo (15 min).

sources.title: La Pastourelle — chambresdhotes.org
sources.claim: La Pastourelle is a 3-Sun Logis B&B on the D155 in Les Nielles, 6 km from Cancale, run by the Ravenoux family.

sources.title: Gîte Le Petit Buot — Gîtes de France 35
sources.claim: Gîte Le Petit Buot is a 30 m² self-catering gîte for 2 at Le Buot, ~€53/night (€371/week), pool access included.

sources.title: Château Richeux — Tripadvisor
sources.claim: Château Richeux is ranked #1 of 12 hotels in Cancale on Tripadvisor (4.6/5 over 486+ reviews); breakfast costs ~€32; Bistro de Cancale is ~10 min drive.

sources.title: Ferme du Vent — Destination Deluxe
sources.claim: Ferme du Vent's design emphasises a slow-life, off-grid retreat with Bains Celtiques spa access in the old farmhouse.

sources.title: Les Rimains — Maisons de Bricourt
sources.claim: Les Rimains is at 62 rue des Rimains, 35260 Cancale — four sea-facing rooms perched on the Cancale cliffs (sister property, not walkable from Le Buot).

sources.title: Maison Tirel-Guérin — Tripadvisor
sources.claim: Maison Tirel-Guérin / Domaine du Limonay is a 4★ hotel near the La Gouesnière-Cancale-St Méloir des Ondes train station — not walkable to Le Coquillage.

sources.title: La Ferme du Vent — Maisons de Bricourt
sources.claim: Official Ferme du Vent property page.
